message.content: {"note_claim": "The PM is the head of cabinet, typically the leader of the party with the majority in the House of Representatives, so one cannot 'run for Prime Minister'.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "The prime minister is the chair of the Cabinet of Australia and thus the head of the federal executive government.", "reason": "The page states the PM chairs Cabinet and has almost always been the leader of the majority party in the House of Representatives, directly substantiating the note's claim."}

parsed.note_claim: The PM is the head of cabinet, typically the leader of the party with the majority in the House of Representatives, so one cannot 'run for Prime Minister'.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The prime minister is the chair of the Cabinet of Australia and thus the head of the federal executive government.
parsed.reason: The page states the PM chairs Cabinet and has almost always been the leader of the majority party in the House of Representatives, directly substantiating the note's claim.
